_about: Public-domain Charles Augustus Briggs (1841-1913), Union Theological Seminary professor of Hebrew and biblical theology, tried for heresy by the Presbyterian Church in 1892-1893, for the Word Hoard: his 1876 inaugural address, Biblical Study (1883), American Presbyterianism (1885), Messianic Prophecy (1886), Whither? (1889), The Authority of Holy Scripture (1891), The Bible, the Church and the Reason (1892), The Higher Criticism of the Hexateuch (1892), The Defence of Professor Briggs (1893), The Messiah of the Gospels (1894), The Messiah of the Apostles (1895), General Introduction to the Study of Holy Scripture (1899), The Incarnation of the Lord (1902), New Light on the Life of Jesus (1904), The Ethical Teaching of Jesus (1904) and the International Critical Commentary on Psalms (2 vols, 1906, with Emilie Grace Briggs), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
